title: Sumerian astronomical knowledge

tellings.quote: You have Sumerian um architecture that shows a precocious knowledge of astronomy.

plain: Michels says that the architecture of Sumer, one of the earliest civilizations in ancient Mesopotamia, shows a knowledge of astronomy that was surprisingly advanced for its time. He says this himself, without naming a source, in a 2022 conversation with the Harvard astronomer Avi Loeb, as one of several hints that ancient people may have known more than we would expect.
